author: GamingBolt
description:
Even with those caveats – and some others, like the overall repetitive nature of combat or the lackluster enemy variety – I can't say that I entirely despised my time with Romeo is a Dead Man. The plot compelled me to keep going, even in places where the sheer pretentiousness or seemingly unexplained twists threatened to lose me. 

And as one-note as the combat could sometimes feel, I can't deny the joy of  reducing my enemies into puddles. While some elements feel strictly “take it or leave it,” as expected with any Suda51 title, some much-needed polish and quality of life could make Romeo is a Dead Man into a far less annoying experience.
title: Romeo Is A Dead Man Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
The rumor mill has already begun to churn out snippets about what the PlayStation 6 could bring to the table to set it apart from a generation of consoles that has done quite well for Sony in the past five years. 

Early reports suggest Sony is aiming to increase memory bandwidth to better support the features that make its games look and feel so good on both PS5 and PS5 Pro, especially ray tracing and PSSR, which will help carry the next generation

But will Sony's admittedly creative approach to achieving its goals be a reality in the long run? Join us as we take a look, and ponder some interesting ramifications for what the PS6 could bring to our screens later in the future.
title: PS6 Rumor Claims 30GB GDDR7 Memory - Here’s Why That’s A Big Deal

author: GamingBolt
description:
It's February, and you know what that means. No, not just the launch of big-name games like Resident Evil Requiem, but the first State of Play for the year. PlayStation has announced a pretty showcase to kick things off with over 60 minutes of news, announcements, reveals, and more from PlayStation Studios and third-party developers worldwide.

Obviously, you should never get too hyped and expect the impossible – like Grand Theft Auto 6, especially when Take-Two specifically said marketing would begin this Summer – but there's plenty more to look forward to. Let's dive into 15 potential announcements that could occur, starting with the most obvious.
title: PlayStation State of Play - 15 HUGE Game Announcements That Could Happen This Week
